description: Turkish Airlines Miles&Smiles Miles and Status Miles. International flights: Miles = distance x booking-class rate with a minimum per class (Economy 25% to 125%; Business 135% or 150% on the Classic card, 160% or 175% on Classic Plus, Elite and Elite Plus); flights within Turkiye (both airports TR) earn fixed Miles by class. Status Miles = the same flights at the Classic card rate. Progress toward Classic Plus (25,000), Elite (40,000) and Elite Plus (80,000) Status Miles in 12 months; sm is the Status Miles so far. Give segs: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and the ISO country codes of its two airports. Takes no price. Uses cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Unofficial.

cls.description: Booking class. C = C (Business 150% (175%)); D = D (Business 150% (175%)); K = K (Business 135% (160%)); J = J (Business 135% (160%)); Z = Z (Business 135% (160%)); Y = Y (Economy 125%); B = B (Economy 125%); M = M (Economy 100%); H = H (Economy 100%); S = S (Economy 100%); E = E (Economy 100%); Q = Q (Economy 100%); A = A (Economy 100%); O = O (Economy 100%); T = T (Economy 50%); L = L (Economy 50%); V = V (Economy 50%); G = G (Economy 50%); W = W (Economy 25%); P = P (Economy 25%); F = F (Economy 25%); U = U (Economy 25%). The letter on your ticket. Turkish Airlines has no First class: F is an Economy class here. Business shows the Classic rate, then the Classic Plus and higher rate.

creditClass.description: The booking class letter for creditTo, when it differs from the class question. Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of Turkish Airlines's own: united = United MileagePlus (creditStatus one of: General member, Premier Silver, Premier Gold, Premier Platinum, Premier 1K); aeroplan = Aeroplan (creditStatus one of: Aeroplan Member, 25K, 35K, 50K, 75K, Super Elite). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. The booking class is cls (or creditClass). The flights are segs (their miles), or creditFlights.

segs.description: The flights, one way and in order, one entry per flight (1 to 8): fromCountry and toCountry, the ISO 3166 two-letter country codes of its two airports; miles, its great-circle distance in miles (1 to 12,500); optional from and to, the IATA codes of its two airports, which label the breakdown; some airlines also use them (Vladivostok, VVO, on JAL and ANA; the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle, MAD-BCN, on Iberia; the long-haul tables named by city on SAS).

from.description: The departure airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

fromCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the departure airport, e.g. DE.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

toCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the arrival airport, e.g. DE.

sm.description: Status Miles you have in the last 12 months (optional). Used only for the progress toward the next tier.

status.description: Your Turkish Airlines tier. CL = Classic; CP = Classic Plus; EL = Elite; EP = Elite Plus. Classic Plus, Elite and Elite Plus earn more in Business. Economy earns the same on every card.

trip.description: Trip. ow = One way; rt = Round trip. Round trip counts the same flights back the other way.
